description.text: The third Neo set, released in 2001 with 66 cards, two of them secret rares, and no theme decks. It completed the 251 Pokémon of the first two generations with Celebi and Johto's Legendary Pokémon, added three more Unown, and introduced Shining Pokémon, the differently colored Pokémon of the games, of which a deck may hold only one each. Its symbol shows Suicune, Entei and Raikou leaving the Burned Tower.

description.text: A copy with the "double holo" look, also called holo bleed, found across Neo Revelation's holo cards: the foil fills the faint white outline that ordinary copies show around the Pokémon. Grading companies name it as an error on the clearest cards, Celebi, Houndoom and Shining Magikarp among them.
